question: A conductor is given some excess charge and kept isolated. Explain where the excess charge resides and why. Give reason.

options.A: The excess charge remains uniformly distributed throughout the volume of the conductor
options.B: The excess charge collects only at the centre of the conductor
options.C: The excess charge disappears because an isolated conductor cannot retain charge
options.D: The excess charge resides on the outer surface; otherwise an internal electric field would persist and free charges would move until equilibrium is reached
